test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce8e61c27b1358047349e8cba095d4ad589b80691c48f5421760664eb3837619.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**1) Every element is moving clockwise direction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8104f59cf08d8c3f97669e532192247e8e10c17bba699cbb783ea77218c6ba64.png] 

**2) One element is omitted in anticlockwise direction in every step and a different element has appeared in every next step.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51d61f6b55fbd04e3d0a0261cf415cc58cfe148eec7b1fcc2453326e9823a72d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acaf19438e17bc6ce9a221fc321daa344a5cf8f6f67eea6ad7d246d98ffca52c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf25b858d84713ba27614ce5f354c5fff345cf858fbf18092feee0cac27d2a15.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c213118f2f1f0755d0e1d5d4c7ebd41334ef4d91d21873ee5114e199504404d9.png] 

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
